output.question: What is Brex's valuation?
output.answer: Brex has no independent valuation any more because Capital One bought it. Capital One announced on April 7, 2026 that the deal had closed. When Capital One announced the agreement on January 22, 2026, it valued the stock-and-cash deal at $5.15 billion, the most recent price put on Brex. Banking Dive reported that Brex shareholders would receive $2.75 billion in cash and 10.6 million Capital One shares, and that the price was nearly 60% below Brex's $12.3 billion valuation in 2021 (PitchBook data).

key_facts.fact: Capital One agreed to acquire Brex in a stock-and-cash deal valued at $5.15 billion. The deal was expected to close in mid-calendar 2026.
Capital One announced that it had completed its acquisition of Brex through a combination of stock and cash.
Brex shareholders were to receive $2.75 billion in cash and 10.6 million Capital One shares, according to Capital One's regulatory filing.
The $5.15 billion price is nearly 60% below Brex's $12.3 billion valuation in 2021 (PitchBook data).

passages.quote: expected to close in the middle of calendar year 2026
Capital One Financial Corporation (NYSE: COF) today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Brex
$2.75 billion in cash and 10.6 million Capital One shares
The sale price is nearly 60% below Brex's $12.3 billion valuation in 2021

caveats: Brex is now a wholly owned part of Capital One, so it has no standalone market valuation. The $5.15 billion figure is the deal value set at announcement.
Part of the price was paid in Capital One stock, so the deal's actual value at closing may have differed from $5.15 billion as COF shares moved.

The cash portion is reported inconsistently: Banking Dive says $2.75 billion, while some secondary sites in search results cite about $2.56 to $2.58 billion. The Capital One press releases I opened did not give the split.
The $12.3 billion peak valuation comes from PitchBook data via Banking Dive. Some secondary sources date that peak to 2022 rather than 2021.
